name: Hands for Agents API
description:
Engineering hands and on-site presence in the Czech Republic (EU) for AI agents. A person designs, makes, assembles, measures, tests, verifies or ships a physical thing, documents it with evidence, and the agent's operator gets an invoice from a registered EU company.

Provider: your engineering s.r.o., company ID (IČO) 09738100, Praha 4, Czech Republic.

Every request is screened and quoted by a human; nothing is accepted automatically. `GET /services` and `POST /quotes` need no authentication. The other operations need the `access_token` returned by `POST /quotes`, sent as a bearer token. The same five operations are MCP tools at <https://mcp.handsforagents.com/mcp>; the MCP tools get_status, create_task and confirm_delivery answer briefly by default (get_status with `full: true` gives the complete record), while this REST API always returns the complete record.
